game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Skating Pond, a frozen skating pond: the firewood keeper must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against frost imps.
theme: Snowy Hold – Skating Pond: a frozen skating pond
core_gameplay_loop: In Skating Pond, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against frost imps. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about spells to power up the firewood keeper and open the chapel bell.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Skating Pond'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Skating Pond.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
